contentText: The mother of an alleged victim of the main suspect in a girl's killing is to sue the French State and the minister of Justice over how minor-related cases are dealt with. This comes after thousands of people protested in Paris on June 8 amid public outrage over the death of an 11-year-old girl. The main suspect in her disappearance and killing had already been flagged multiple times in minor-related cases. FRANCE 24's James André tells us more.
